exceptions_retained_as_runtime: All fenced commands and any command-adjacent claim that asserts a result, prerequisite, or observable effect remain RUNTIME_CHECK; a source/signature check may complement but never replace scoped execution evidence.
Hardware/verification thresholds, storage/port rules, system effects, pricing/finance/legal claims, and Volume lifecycle semantics remain in their existing stricter lanes.
Existing PASS or partial self-test, SSH, Jupyter, and Volume records retain their exact artifact limits; this audit supplies no status promotion.
